index idx_chat_classification_events_session: CREATE INDEX idx_chat_classification_events_session ON chat_classification_events (session_id, at)
index idx_chat_session_shares_subject: CREATE INDEX idx_chat_session_shares_subject ON chat_session_shares (subject_kind, subject_id)
table chat_classification_events: CREATE TABLE chat_classification_events ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, at TEXT NOT NULL, from_level TEXT, to_level TEXT NOT NULL, cause TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' ) STRICT
table chat_session_settings: CREATE TABLE chat_session_settings ( session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, effort TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, level_id TEXT REFERENCES classification_levels(id), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES chat_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
table chat_session_shares: CREATE TABLE chat_session_shares ( session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_kind IN ('user', 'group')), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id, subject_kind, subject_id) ) STRICT
table classification_assignments: CREATE TABLE classification_assignments ( kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('pool', 'tool', 'mcp', 'connector', 'collection')), id TEXT NOT NULL, level_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classification_levels(id), over TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hide' CHECK (over IN ('hide', 'gate')), PRIMARY KEY (kind, id) ) STRICT
table classification_data_classes: CREATE TABLE classification_data_classes ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', level_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classification_levels(id), patterns TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', rule_question TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', rule_positive TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', rule_negative TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', rule_threshold REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5 CHECK (rule_threshold >= 0 AND rule_threshold <= 1), action TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'raise' CHECK (action IN ('raise', 'confirm', 'block')), terms_uploaded_by TEXT, terms_uploaded_at TEXT ) STRICT
table classification_levels: CREATE TABLE classification_levels ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, rank INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (rank >= 0), name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'neutral' CHECK (color IN ('neutral', 'info', 'success', 'warning', 'error')), marking_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', mip_label_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', filename_tag TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' ) STRICT
table classification_markings: CREATE TABLE classification_markings ( kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('mip', 'tscp', 'sensitivity', 'stamp')), value TEXT NOT NULL, level_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classification_levels(id), PRIMARY KEY (kind, value) ) STRICT
table classification_terms: CREATE TABLE classification_terms ( class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classification_data_classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, term TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (class_id, term) ) STRICT
table pools: CREATE TABLE "pools" ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, kind TEXT NOT NULL, -- chat|transcription|embedding|image|speech strategy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'least_inflight', -- least_inflight|round_robin fallback_offline TEXT, -- model id for known-but-down spill enforce_limits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- 0/1 (count toward quotas?) allowed_groups TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', -- JSON array of group names sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- deterministic iteration order created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT
trigger classification_assignments_follow_pool_delete: CREATE TRIGGER classification_assignments_follow_pool_delete AFTER DELETE ON pools BEGIN DELETE FROM classification_assignments WHERE kind = 'pool' AND id = OLD.name; END
trigger classification_assignments_follow_pool_rename: CREATE TRIGGER classification_assignments_follow_pool_rename AFTER UPDATE OF name ON pools WHEN OLD.name <> NEW.name BEGIN UPDATE classification_assignments SET id = NEW.name WHERE kind = 'pool' AND id = OLD.name; END
